build_code_builder: build a python module to generate code strings line by line with automatic indentation
create_code_builder_block: create a CodeBuilder block with optional header line and braces for nested code sections
create_code_builder_function: create a CodeBuilder function block with a function signature and indented body
create_code_builder_struct: create a CodeBuilder struct block with a struct name and indented members
test_code_builder_to_string: test the CodeBuilder to_string method returns the complete assembled code string
